mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can potentiate tamsulosin's vasodilatory effects and increase orthostatic hypotension risk.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and blood pressure closely; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation; consider alternative antifungal if possible; counsel patient on orthostatic precautions.
